title: Syrian-Style Stuffed Tofu
description: A flavorful and healthy dish that combines the richness of tofu with the spices of Syrian cuisine. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: 2. Cut the tofu into small cubes and set aside.
3. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
4. Add the Syrian spice blend and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
5. Add the pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
6. Add the tofu and stir to combine with the pilaf mixture.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, until lightly browned.
